reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is internally contradictory (claiming reduced grain boundary cohesion improves toughness) and the proposed mechanism (crack initiation along grain boundaries) would promote, not prevent, brittle behavior.
reasons.testability: The test compares against 'conventional alloys' rather than the required baseline of the same HEA without the treatment, and the falsification criterion is misaligned with the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is fundamentally flawed and would misdirect research, offering no useful insight into toughness degradation in single-phase HEAs.
